stem_md: 计算 $\int_\Gamma xyz\,dz$，$\Gamma$ 为平面 $y=z$ 截单位球面所得曲线，从 $z$ 轴正方向看沿逆时针方向。
analysis_md:
解：因在 $\Gamma$ 上有 $x^2+2y^2=1$，故 $\Gamma$：

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x&=\cos t\\y&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\sin t\\z&=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\sin t\end{aligned}\right.\quad(0\leq t\leq2\pi)
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{原式}&=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\int_0^{2\pi}\cos^2t\sin^2t\,\mathrm{d}t
=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\cdot4\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^2t(1-\cos^2t)\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&=\sqrt{2}\left(\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{3}{4}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=\frac{\sqrt{2}\pi}{16}
\end{aligned}
$$
